title: Faster algorithm
summary: Macro route has actual three-component common-edge and overlap-chain children. Joint common-edge cover emits [2,2,2]; chain edge choices yield one mass<1 and one mass>1 at2.31, so universal cheap selection is open. Paid cover route is testing entry/payment. A separate root-owned global balanced-cover route is active. All three milestones remain open.
